newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel, Dassault to hold news conference.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel, Dassault to hold news conference.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom chairman Serge Tchuruk and Dassault Industrie head Serge Dassault will host a news conference in Paris on Tuesday on their joint bid for the state's 58 percent stake in Thomson-CSF.
A spokesman for Alcatel said the conference would start at 0900 GMT at Dassault's headquarters on the Champs Elysees.

The two companies had originally planned to hold a news conference in April but decided to postpone the conference when there were signs President Jacques Chirac would call an early parliamentary election.
Alcatel and Dassault, as well as rival Lagardere Groupe submitted bids on May 7 for the state's stake in the defence electronics group Thomson-CSF.
Lagardere that day said it counted British Aerospace Plc and Germany's Daimler-Benz Aerospace among its allies. GEC Plc has signed memoranda of understanding with both bidders.
